notes: Field frame: u along the long axis (76.18 deg, towards the north goal), v to its left (west). Most field-related outlines were read in that frame on brightness/colour profiles of the 2020 ortho and converted to model x, y, then checked on --plan overlays at 16-20 px/m. Turf (2020 ortho): straight sides on the white edge strip at |v| = 32.1; north apron a true arc R 34 centred on the axis 35.5 m north of centre (apex 69.5 m), meeting the sides at u = 46.7 at a slight angle; south apron R 42.4 (apex 66.9 m) meeting the sides at u = -52.2. Apron readings scatter about 1 m (NW and SW edges run ~1 m outside the arcs). In 2025 photos (0151, 0163) an asphalt walk and the black netting cross the north apron 3-6 m beyond the end line; the ortho shows a lighter band there, kept as North_cross_walk. Ring walk: west edge on the grandstand front (v 37.4), east edge on the bleacher front (v -36.2), north curb arc concentric with the turf arc, R 37.9; there is no walk round the south apron (lawn and trees, 0163). Stands: outlines from the ortho roofs, which agree with OSM 232846650/232846674 to ~0.5 m; rows and sections counted on the drone photos (see stands[].count_note). Press box: OSM 232846675 and a 13.3 m LiDAR 2017 return; not distinct in the ortho. Lot 42: hedge-side curb and both stall rows from the ortho (stall lines located as brightness peaks along offset rows); building wall on the north-east from OSM; drive connections from OSM aisle 232846631 (north, beyond y -70, and south to Carlisle Rd at y -158 to -168). Light poles: five, as in photos 0147/0151/0163 (NW and SW of the west stand, the antenna mast behind the press box, N and S ends of the east bleachers); only the SW pole is in the 2017 LiDAR (24.5 m); the mast is from OSM; the other three are placed from photos and ortho shadows and are UNVERIFIED to 2-3 m. Trees: crown tops and radii from the 2017 LiDAR nDSM (hedge, stand and building returns excluded). Hedge height 6.5 m from the LiDAR. Scoreboard projected from two oblique drone photos (UNVERIFIED +-3 m). Football markings are not traced: they are to be generated from field_frame. The 2017 LiDAR predates the present west grandstand, so no stand heights were taken from it. Not digitised: gates, the flagpole south-east of the south apron, the practice-area goal boxes, the north buildings (other zone), the Carlisle Rd and Normal Ave carriageways and sidewalks (other zones). Correction: an earlier note said the 2017 LiDAR does not show the west grandstand. That was an error in the fetch tool, which dropped every 10 m block without ground returns. The stand is in the cloud, classed as ground: its seating deck rises 5.7 m over 20 m. The build leaves those returns out of the ground and takes the stand height from them. Lacrosse and field hockey lines (markings Lax_W_*, Lax_M_*, FH_*) are drawn to the rule books on field_frame, never traced. The 2020 ortho shows faint women's lacrosse lines (goal circles fitted at u +-45.7 with r 2.55, 14.6 m fans centred there, a 9.1 m centre circle) and men's creases (u +36.4 and -36.7, r 2.7): women's goals on the football goal lines (100 yd apart), men's 80 yd apart. The 2025 photos (0151, 0163) show the colours: women's lacrosse thin white, men's lacrosse black (creases, end lines 15 yd behind the goals, box and wing lines 10 yd in from the 60 yd sidelines), field hockey red (100 x 60 yd outline on the football goal lines, shooting circles 16 yd from the posts, wider than the lacrosse fans; not seen in the 2020 ortho, so painted after 2020). Lines that fall on a football line (restraining lines, 23 m lines, centre lines, the goal lines inside the women's circles) are not drawn twice. The midfield hawk logo is not drawn (the university's artwork).

field_frame.evidence: ortho2020: the four white boundary lines found as brightness peaks on profiles taken in a rotated frame (end lines at u = -54.93/+54.94, sidelines at v = -24.40/+24.39, constant to 0.05 m along their length, so the angle is good to ~0.05 deg); rectangle of exactly 109.73 x 48.77 m fitted to the line centres; goal lines check at +-45.8 (91.44 m apart)

markings.unverified: line width; the 3 m centre line lies on the football 50 yd line; the hawk logo inside the circle is not drawn (the university's artwork)

markings.name: FH_pitch_outline
markings.evidence: NCAA field hockey rule 1 (100 x 60 yd, circle 16 yd (14.63 m) from the inside of posts 4 yd (3.66 m) apart); 2025 photos 0151, 0163 (red pitch outline on the football goal lines, red circles wider than the white lacrosse fans); not seen in ortho2020
markings.unverified: line width 75 mm (FIH); the back lines lie on the football goal lines, which cover them between the sidelines; the 23 m and centre lines lie on football lines and are not drawn; penalty spots and corner marks not drawn

stands.name: West_grandstand
stands.count_note: rows: brightness profile across the seat deck in msu_sprague_..._0151_D.jpg gives 22 riser/plank periods (+-1) between the front concourse and the back rail; sections: 4 aisles with handrails cross the deck, each opposite one of the 4 stair towers from the front concourse (0151, 0147), so 5 sections
stands.evidence: ortho2020 (outline, front edge v=37.4 on the field frame); osm 232846650; photos 0151, 0147, 0163; lidar2017 (back edge height)
stands.unverified: footprint read from the roof in the ortho, which may be shifted ~1-2 m west by relief; rows +-1; aisle count from oblique views; the south-west notch (8 m by 6 m) from ortho and OSM; row rise 0.205 m puts the top row 5.7 m up, the height of the back edge of the stand in the 2017 LiDAR (where the stand is classed as ground: a profile at y -150 rises from 115.6 m at the front to 121.3 m at the back); whether the stand of the 2025 photographs is that same stand is not known

stands.name: East_bleachers
stands.count_note: 7 sections divided by 6 red stepped aisles, plus red end stairs at both ends (0163, 0151); aisle gaps also read on the ortho every ~10.2 m at u = -24.9, -14.7, -4.5, 5.6, 15.9, 26.0; rows: 9 plank periods on a profile across one section in 0151
stands.unverified: rows +-1 (only blurred top views); back wall height

stands.evidence: osm 232846675; lidar2017 (13.3 m high return at -391.2, -147.2); photos 0147, 0163, C04A0106 (red box with grey field face, next to the antenna mast)
stands.unverified: not distinct in the 2020 ortho; footprint and height from OSM and the 2017 LiDAR, which predates the present stand
